concepts.name: The dot product
concepts.summary: u.v = sum of u_i*v_i = |u||v|cos(theta): one scalar of alignment between two vectors — large when they point the same way, zero when perpendicular, negative when opposed. Pure linear algebra; grows with dimension d. (Upstairs it is attention's query.key score, scaled by 1/sqrt(d).)

concepts.name: Softmax
concepts.summary: weight_i = e^(s_i)/sum_j e^(s_j): exponentiate (positive, amplify gaps) then normalize (sum to 1). Turns any list of scores into positive weights that sum to one, with a temperature to sharpen or soften. (Upstairs it is attention's second half, blending values.)
